applyTo: "apps/web/**"

# Web app instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md`.

- Respect web bootstrap, providers, navigation, and feature boundaries.
- Import `@nexus/*` via public APIs only.
- Do not import `@sujeetd7/ai-engineering-*` into web runtime.
- UI via `@nexus/shared-ui` (Tamagui-backed). No MUI/Tailwind token systems.
